session_definition: CME session 18:00-17:00 America/New_York, labelled by the date it ENDS on
notes: LIVE_FORWARD holds no historical data. It accepts only sessions that START at or after the V5 FINAL_COHORT_FREEZE timestamp.

None of these historical periods is unseen: QuantLabV4 evaluated strategies on exactly the VALIDATION (V4 CONFIRMATION), HISTORICAL_AUDIT_1 (V4 FINAL_HISTORICAL_HOLDOUT) and HISTORICAL_AUDIT_2 (V4 SEALED_2026_AUDIT) periods, and V2/V3 examined them too. Only LIVE_FORWARD is genuinely out-of-sample.
The `registry` section is written once by research/s00_bootstrap.py and never edited.
